steps.name: Sample structure QC
steps.context: Inputs: /eval-eight-arms-with-qc-only-n6-1/data/inputs/counts/counts.csv (12,000 genes x 13 samples, gene symbols in first column, gene-level counts from Salmon) and /eval-eight-arms-with-qc-only-n6-1/data/inputs/metadata/metadata.csv (12 rows, condition: atopic dermatitis lesional vs control, 6 vs 6, unpaired, single batch). No differential expression, no enrichment — QC only. No reference data needed.
steps.question: How do the 12 samples look — library sizes, PCA structure, sample-to-sample distances — and what is the verdict on the shallow sample (sample_01)?

grounding.reason: Sample structure QC on 12-sample two-group count data: blind vst, PCA on top 500 variable genes, sample distance heatmap (R-0033@40bf); shallow sample kept and reported (R-0008@440d)

constraints: low_depth_policy = keep_inspect_report (R-0008@440d): keep sample_01 through QC, report it beside the others, remove only with a stated reason
transform = vst blind to the design (R-0033@40bf)
No pre-filtering, no normalization outside DESeq2's median-of-ratios size factors; counts used as provided
Color PCA and distance heatmap by condition; single batch so batch coloring is not applicable but state that
steps.description: Read counts and metadata, set condition factor with control as explicit reference level. Build a DESeq2 dataset without pre-filtering (QC keeps the full picture). Compute library sizes and the number of detected genes (counts > 0) per sample; report sample_01's size factor and depth relative to the median. Apply varianceStabilizingTransformation with blind=TRUE, run PCA (plotPCA) on the 500 most variable genes colored by condition, and compute the Euclidean sample-to-sample distance matrix on vst values with a pheatmap (colored by condition). Also report hierarchical clustering order. Deliver a verdict on sample_01: its depth, its position on PC1/PC2, its mean distance to its own group vs the other samples' mean within-group distances, and whether it clusters with its condition — with removal left as an explicit, reasoned judgment, not automatic.
acceptance_criteria: Per-sample table: condition, library size, size factor, detected gene count, depth relative to median
PCA plot on 500 top-variance genes colored by condition, with sample labels
Sample-to-sample Euclidean distance heatmap on vst values with condition annotation
Verdict on sample_01 stated explicitly: depth, PCA position, mean within-group vs cross-group distance, and a keep/remove recommendation with reason
Overall QC verdict on whether the design is clean for downstream DE

steps.name: QC report with reproducibility record
steps.context: Consolidates T1S1 outputs into a single QC report answering the research question.
steps.question: What do the twelve samples look like overall, and what is the verdict on sample_01?

grounding.reason: Report step consolidating QC outputs with a reproducibility record per R-0086@becf

constraints: Report the p-value-independent diagnostics only; no differential expression is tested in this run
steps.description: Assemble the per-sample QC table, the PCA, the distance heatmap, and the sample_01 verdict into one report with a reproducibility record: sessionInfo, package versions (DESeq2 1.52.0), and a note that no random seed was needed (deterministic transforms). State the input files and that the analysis is QC-only, with no DE inference drawn.
acceptance_criteria: Single report file containing QC table, both plots, the sample_01 verdict, and sessionInfo

plan.title: AD skin sample structure QC: depths, PCA, distances
plan.analytical_narrative: The question is QC-only: before any differential testing, characterize the 12 skin samples (6 AD lesional vs 6 control, unpaired, single batch, 12,000 genes, raw Salmon gene-level counts). Per the grounded procedure (R-0033@40bf), run a blind variance-stabilizing transformation, a PCA on the 500 most variable genes, and a sample-to-sample Euclidean distance heatmap, with library sizes and detected-gene counts tabulated per sample. Sample_01 is flagged with a library size ~4x below the median; per R-0008@440d it is kept, inspected on the PCA and distance heatmap, and reported beside the others with a stated verdict — removal is a judgment, not a default. The output is a QC report with a verdict on whether sample_01 (and any other sample) departs from its group and whether the design supports downstream DE.
